🎙 Remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the APEC CEO Summit (Shenzhen, November 18, 2026) Ahead of the Session, the Russian President spoke briefly with Prime Minister of Malaysia Anwar Ibrahim. 💬 Vladimir Putin: The Asia-Pacific region has become the centre of the global economy and the world’s leading industrial and technological hub. It is home to major consumer markets , leading global companies and a dvanced centres of research and education . #APEC economies account for: • over 60% of global GDP; • 36% of the world’s population; • 50% of global trade in goods; • 35% of global trade in services; • over 60% of global foreign direct investment. The Asia-Pacific offers a clear example of how a fairer, more democratic world order based on equality is taking shape , as the old centralised hierarchy gives way to an extensive network of horizontal ties. *** ☝️ Experience has shown that the old instruments of economic domination and coercion have run their course and lost much of their power to intimidate. Yes, sanctions, tariffs and export restrictions can still slow growth, but they can no longer bring it to a halt , let alone crush a competitor’s economy. The failed attempts to isolate our own country, Russia, are a case in point . We have faced unprecedented sanctions pressure, with more punitive measures imposed on us than on any other country in the world. Yet thanks to our geographical position, the character of our peoples and the role we play in the global economy and in world affairs, we have come through all these trials with dignity . Let me stress that when economies are so closely linked, artificial barriers at any point in a value chain raise costs throughout the rest of the chain . This is precisely what we see in countries that actively impose sanctions on Russia or anyone else. 📉 The EU , for example, has been unable to adapt to the consequences of its own measures , including its decisions to give up access to our market and cut off the reliable supply of affordable Russian energy that underpinned its prosperity for decades. I ts industrial capacity is shrinking and it is losing ground to its competitors. Budget deficits have become a pressing concern, debt burdens are growing and inflation is rising. All this weighs heavily on European businesses and citizens . Living standards in Europe continue to fall – a humiliation for the eurozone . *** For Russia, the Asia-Pacific is a key region for trade and economic cooperation. In 2014, the region accounted for over a quarter of our foreign trade, and we set ourselves the long-term target of raising that share to 40%. Today, it already accounts for over half of Russia’s trade with the world – 53%. We propose that APEC step up its efforts to strengthen logistics links and transport networks to keep pace with the profound changes in the global economy and the substantial growth in the region’s export potential. Russia can offer a wide range of transit routes by land and sea. APEC offers ample scope for constructive dialogue at all levels , above all among the leaders of major economies. They can sit down together to exchange views , resolve differences between their countries on political, economic and security issues by seeking compromise and balancing interests, and work together to strengthen the foundations for sustainable development worldwide. 🇷🇺 🇨🇳 🇺🇸 That is why I see great potential in the upcoming trilateral meeting of the Leaders of Russia, China and the US , scheduled to take place on the sidelines of the APEC Summit. Этой ночью дежурные средства ПВО сбили 184 украинских БпЛА самолетного типа. Дроны перехвачены над Белгородской и Ростовской областями, а также над Краснодарским краем, Республикой Крым и акваторией Азовского моря. И численно, и географически это значительно меньшая интенсивность атак, чем в предыдущие дни, и в большинстве случаев это наблюдается перед новым массированным налетом, в т.ч. на столичный регион. Восемь пострадавших и три пожара: последствия атаки ВСУ на Краснодарский край Минувшей ночью Краснодарский край и Республика Адыгея подверглись атаке противника. По сообщениям оперштаба, враг нанёс удары по жилым районам, в результате чего пострадали восемь человек. В Краснодарском крае обломки БПЛА упали на территории двух предприятий, вызвав возгорание. В поселке Энем (Республика Адыгея) дрон ВСУ ударил по пятиэтажке. Глава Мурат Кумпилов сообщил, что пострадали четыре человека. @wargonzo

После статьи Bild, теперь уже Bloomberg пишет, что Россия предлагает НАТО отказаться от размещения войск во всех странах, вступивших в альянс после 1997 года. В обмен Москва готова сократить свое военное присутствие в Калининградской области (???) и Беларуси. По данным агентства, американские представители обсуждают с Россией и Украиной новые правила для НАТО, размещение вооружений и войск в Европе в рамках соглашения о завершении войны. При этом США уже спрашивали Киев, готов ли он уступить России Донбасс в обмен на членство Украины в НАТО. При этом агентство пишет, что на саммите ЕС 13 ноября европейские лидеры отвергли возможность отвода войск НАТО из Восточной Европы. Некоторые лидеры Европы предложили вновь обсудить перспективы вступления Украины в НАТО. Несколько участников саммита также признали, что в будущем возможны изменения границ, если на это согласится Киев. БС в TG ✊ | БС в МАХ 🤫

📝 A Ball with Instructions 📝 What The Economist "predicted" for 2027 What will globalists do next year? The Economist magazine answers in its annual cover puzzle The World Ahead 2027. It's customary to read it as a "prophecy," but it's more accurate to consider it an agenda. 🔻 What's on the cover ▪️ An illustration in the form of a sphere in red, black and white colors was drawn by artist Cleon Peterson. It depicts world leaders, missiles and satellites, AI symbols, a falling stock market chart, money, the Spasskaya Tower, the Arc de Triomphe, tanks and tents with people. ▪️ The editorial board named ten major themes of the year. Among them are "the post-Trump era," consequences of war with Iran, another temperature record, discontent with AI, right-wing populists in Europe, pressure on the bond market, threats to Taiwan, the "Ozempic effect," cheap space launches and a Hollywood reboot. 🖍 The magazine, read by boards of directors, ministries and investment funds, shows the Western elite in advance what to think about and what to bet on in the near future. 🔻 Where the money will flow If you read the issue as an instruction for financial institutions, the bets are laid out quite clearly: ▪️ Debt . "Something somewhere has to break" — that's how the editorial board writes about wealthy countries living beyond their means. France is singled out separately: Le Pen's victory, in their assessment, will "frighten the bond markets." In fact, this is a signal to shift out of French government debt. ▪️ AI . The magazine warns of a crash risk: AI companies are accumulating debt through "complex and opaque deals." At the same time, the editorial board calls fears about job losses exaggerated. In other words, AI itself is not the enemy; the bubble around it is dangerous. ▪️ New directions : renewable energy (Trump, according to the magazine, "inadvertently became its best salesman"), longevity pharmaceuticals riding the "Ozempic" wave, and commercial space with Starship and data centers in orbit. ▪️ Raw materials : fertilizer shortages and threats to food security after the Iran war. 🚩 A separate story — Russia . It's not among the ten themes, but it is on the cover: the Spasskaya Tower, a damaged pipe, a tanker in chains on the Red Sea and a red rider next to the Kremlin (a metaphor for Putin). Russia in this picture is a force that sits in the saddle and influences energy, routes and the balance in Europe. It's no coincidence that a severed pipeline and a shackled tanker are depicted nearby: the world's energy map has been redrawn, and this is factored into any calculations.
